```artifact
Feature: Software Engineering Process Coordination

  Scenario: Coordinate every activity in the Software Engineering process
    Given the Hospital has decided to provide quality medicines via authorized Chemists located within the zone at discounted prices
    And the Hospital has decided to provide door-step Laboratory services wherever possible via specimen collection
    When Prof. Chandrasekaran and other esteemed staff of NITK Computer Science & Engineering Department guide the process
    Then every activity is coordinated successfully

  Scenario: Provide quality medicines via authorized Chemists
    Given the Hospital has decided to provide quality medicines via authorized Chemists located within the zone at discounted prices
    When a patient requests a medicine
    Then the authorized Chemist provides the medicine at a discounted price

  Scenario: Provide door-step Laboratory services
    Given the Hospital has decided to provide door-step Laboratory services wherever possible via specimen collection
    When a patient requests a laboratory test
    Then the specimen is collected at the patient's doorstep

  Scenario Outline: Medicine prices
    Given the Hospital has decided to provide quality medicines via authorized Chemists located within the zone at discounted prices
    When a patient requests a medicine with price <price>
    Then the authorized Chemist provides the medicine at the discounted price <price>

    Examples:
      | price  |
      | 0.0    |
      | 10.0   |
      | 20.0   |
      | 50.0   |
      | -10.0  |

  Scenario Outline: Error handling
    Given the Hospital has decided to provide quality medicines via authorized Chemists located within the zone at discounted prices
    When a patient requests a medicine with an invalid price <price>
    Then an error message is displayed with code <code>

    Examples:
      | price  | code  |
      | -10.0  | 404   |
      | 100.0  | 500   |

  Scenario: Staff guidance
    Given Prof. Chandrasekaran and other esteemed staff of NITK Computer Science & Engineering Department guide the process
    When a staff member requests guidance
    Then the guidance is provided successfully

  Scenario: Staff guidance - other staff member
    Given Prof. Chandrasekaran and other esteemed staff of NITK Computer Science & Engineering Department guide the process
    When another staff member requests guidance
    Then the guidance is provided successfully
```
